BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION 1.     Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the B3-2 Community Shopping

District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 13-1 in an area bound by




A line 150.86 feet north of and parallel to West Winnemac Avenue; North Westem

Avenue; a line 120.86 feet north of and parallel to West Winnemac Avenue; And the

public alley next west of and parallel to North Westem Avenue




to those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.




Common Address of Property: 5040 North Western Avenue
